name: change_world
description: Apply one settled world change to match the story. Set `verb` to pick the change and fill that verb's own fields. One call makes one change.

AddTrait.description: Add a lasting condition or quality to an entity.

entity_id.description: Exact entity id. An actor must be here with the player.

name.description: The trait's display name, such as `Battle Worn`; its id is derived.

text.description: The trait's effect in plain language.

AddTrait.title: AddTrait

AdvanceThreadArm.description: Update an active storyline's status or note.

thread_id.description: Exact id of an ACTIVE THREAD.

status.description: New status, or null to keep the current status.

note.description: New private note for the Director, or null to keep the current note.

AdvanceThreadArm.title: AdvanceThreadArm

GainImprovisedItem.description: Give the player an ordinary, unimportant object not already in the world.

item_name.description: The object's name, such as `a handful of gravel`.

GainImprovisedItem.title: GainImprovisedItem

JoinParty.description: Add an actor here to the player's party.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor joining.

JoinParty.title: JoinParty

Kill.description: Record that an actor has died. Their body and what they carried stay in the world.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor who has died. They must be here with the player.

Kill.title: Kill

LeaveParty.description: Remove an actor from the player's party.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor leaving.

LeaveParty.title: LeaveParty

Move.description: Move an actor to a new location, or move a nearby item.

entity_id.description: Exact actor or item id. The item must be carried by the player or loose here.

to_id.description: Exact destination id. An actor moves to a location id. An item is taken by moving it to `player`, handed over by moving it to an actor here, and dropped by moving it to the id of the player's current location.

Move.title: Move

RemoveTrait.description: Remove a lasting condition or quality that has ended.

entity_id.description: Exact entity id. An actor must be here with the player.

trait_id.description: Exact id of one of the entity's traits.

RemoveTrait.title: RemoveTrait

Reveal.description: Make a hidden entity known when the player notices, finds, or reaches it.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the hidden entity.

Reveal.title: Reveal

UnlockExit.description: Unlock an exit from the player's location.

to_id.description: Exact id of the exit's destination.

UnlockExit.title: UnlockExit

change.description: The one world change to apply; `verb` picks the change.

name: roll_attempt
description: Roll an actor's risky attempt directly. For the player, use `stake_attempt` first unless they already accepted the exact `risk`.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the player or actor here who takes the action.

goal.description: The actor's goal, in one line.

risk.description: One-line cost of a bad roll. There is no roll without one.

hit.description: True when a bad roll means physical harm to the actor.

skill.description: Matching skill from the actor's sheet, or empty for d6.

helped.description: Helpful circumstance that adds d6. Empty when using `helper_id` or no help.

helper_id.description: Exact id of an ally here who adds their skill die, or null for no helper.

helper_skill.description: Matching skill from the helper's sheet, or empty for their d6.

hindered.description: Hindering circumstance that lowers the actor's die to d4, such as an injury trait in the way or a heavy load; empty when nothing hinders.

luck_test.description: Separate bad luck that may arrive, or empty for no test.

name: stake_attempt
description: Show the player one attempt's `risk` and let them accept or revise it before rolling.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the player or actor here who takes the action.

goal.description: The actor's goal, in one line.

risk.description: One-line cost of a bad roll. There is no roll without one.

hit.description: True when a bad roll means physical harm to the actor.

skill.description: Matching skill from the actor's sheet, or empty for d6.

helped.description: Helpful circumstance that adds d6. Empty when using `helper_id` or no help.

helper_id.description: Exact id of an ally here who adds their skill die, or null for no helper.

helper_skill.description: Matching skill from the helper's sheet, or empty for their d6.

hindered.description: Hindering circumstance that lowers the actor's die to d4, such as an injury trait in the way or a heavy load; empty when nothing hinders.

luck_test.description: Separate bad luck that may arrive, or empty for no test.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the player or actor here facing bad luck.

subject.description: Possible bad luck, such as low ammo or nearby guards.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the player or an actor here.

amount.description: Positive pays the actor; negative charges them.

name: complete_chapter
description: Record that the current job has ended.

name: buy_gear
description: Buy one catalogue item at its printed price, charged to the buyer. Most cost ₡1. For sale: vest, battle-armor (₡2), hardsuit (₡3), cyber-ear, cyber-eye, cyber-limb, cranial-jack, healing-nanobots, toxin-filter, voice-mimic, flamethrower, low-g-jetpack, med-scanner, mini-drone, repair-tools, survey-pack, grenades, pistol, rifle, shotgun, stun-baton, tranq-gun. Every starship already has the basic version of each function below; one of their upgrades costs ₡10 and needs `onto_id`. Comms: Upgrade with eavesdropper, jammer, tachyon-burst. Crafts: Comes with escape pod. Upgrade with fighter, shuttle. Drive: FTL jump and sublight speeds. Upgrade with longer-jumps, faster-speed, greater-agility. Equipment: Vac suits for crew. Upgrade with armory, heavy-loader, mining-gear, tow-cable. Hull armor: Breaks harmlessly for defense. Upgrade with reentry-rated, sun-shielding. Sensors: Upgrade with deep-space, life-sign-scan, planetary-survey, tactical-vessel-scan. Weapons: Deflector turrets. Upgrade with laser-cutter, military-grade-turret, torpedos.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the player or an actor here who pays.

gear_id.description: Exact id of a catalogue entry.

onto_id.description: Exact id of the ship a ship upgrade is installed in, or null to be carried.

name: advance
description: Spend one advance a party member has earned, when the player asks for it. Choose one skill this job improves. Raise an existing skill one step or add a new one at d8.

parameters.description: The skill increase earned by one job.

subject_id.description: Exact id of the party member who advances.

skill.description: Title-case skill to raise one step or add at d8.

why.description: One short reason, in the fiction, for the change.
